announcements_content_check.name: announcements_content_check
announcements_content_check.value: "announcements"."body" is not null or "announcements"."pdf_media_id" is not null

schedule_periods_yearly_check.name: schedule_periods_yearly_check
schedule_periods_yearly_check.value: not "schedule_periods"."yearly" or ("schedule_periods"."valid_from" is not null and "schedule_periods"."valid_to" is not null)

service_exceptions_add_check.name: service_exceptions_add_check
service_exceptions_add_check.value: "service_exceptions"."kind" <> 'add' or ("service_exceptions"."location_id" is not null and "service_exceptions"."time" is not null and "service_exceptions"."service_type" is not null)
